context_requirements: High TBXAS1 expression and active thromboxane A2 synthesis
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines

evidence.supports: Thromboxane synthase inhibition blocks glioma motility, induces apoptosis, and radiosensitizes glioma cells
Thromboxane synthase is expressed in endothelial cells and its inhibition blocks migration and induces apoptosis
Thromboxane synthase inhibitors induce apoptosis in migration-arrested glioma cells
Thromboxane synthase inhibitor benzylimidazole alters arachidonic acid epoxygenation in a chick embryo model
